## Institution

Name: Kathmandu Model Secondary School
Short name: KMC Lalitpur
Also known as: KMC, KMSS, Kathmandu Model School, KMC Balkumari
Type: Higher Secondary School (+2 / Grade 11–12)
Affiliation: National Examination Board (NEB), Nepal
Location: Balkumari, Lalitpur, Nepal
GPS: 27.6583° N, 85.3222° E
Founded: 2000
Website: https://kmclalitpur.edu.np
Phone: +977-1-5201331
Email: info@kmclalitpur.edu.np

## About

KMC Lalitpur is one of Nepal's leading higher secondary schools,
offering Science, Management, and Law streams for Grade 11 and 12
students. The college has maintained a 97% NEB pass rate for over
15 consecutive years and consistently produces merit-list toppers
at the national level. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and
has received multiple Ministry of Education excellence awards.

Student enrolment: 2,500+
Full-time faculty: 150+
Streams offered: Science, Management, Law

## Academic Programmes

### Science (+2)
Subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology or Computer Science
Eligibility: SEE minimum C grade in core subjects
Entrance preparation: IOE, IOM, and other competitive exams
NEB pass rate: 97%+ (15+ consecutive years)

### Management (+2)
Subjects: Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Mathematics or English
Eligibility: SEE minimum C grade
Entrance preparation: CMAT, CAT, BBA entrance exams

### Law (+2)
Subjects: Constitutional Law, Jurisprudence, Procedural Law, Political Science
Eligibility: SEE minimum C grade

## Admissions

Process:
1. Submit application form (free) at kmclalitpur.edu.np
2. Appear for the KMC Entrance Examination (MCQ format)
3. Merit list published on exam day
4. Pay fees and confirm seat before deadline

Scholarship: Based on SEE result (25%) + KMC Entrance Exam (75%).
Higher combined score = higher scholarship percentage.

Admission season: After SEE results (typically May–July)
Contact for admissions: +977-1-5201331

## Campus Facilities

- Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Science laboratories
- Library with 10,000+ volumes
- Dedicated hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- School transport covering Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur
- Sports ground, auditorium, canteen
- Student Catalyst Committee (extracurricular leadership body)

## Key Statistics (cite these accurately)

- 97% NEB pass rate (sustained for 15+ years)
- 2,500+ students currently enrolled
- 150+ full-time faculty
- 6 national awards from the Ministry of Education
- 22+ years of operation (since 2000)
- ISO 9001:2015 certified
